### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/service-analytics`, touching **6** documentable anchor(s).

⛔ **3** release-owned page(s) name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-5.mdx`  _(via AnalyticsService (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-6.mdx`  _(via AnalyticsService (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-7.mdx`  _(via AnalyticsService (symbol, a top-level class))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **58** of **210** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **10** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 91a423ef6b94a86be8874f1ac6449b406a8971c8` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `c369804aa6ef15d92e7d4221fd6c7e9a4ee176b3` — the merge of head `670a779093bce77b73cb2fd370e68510c8f69e62` into base `91a423ef6b94a86be8874f1ac6449b406a8971c8`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin c369804aa6ef15d92e7d4221fd6c7e9a4ee176b3 && git checkout c369804aa6ef15d92e7d4221fd6c7e9a4ee176b3
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 91a423ef6b94a86be8874f1ac6449b406a8971c8 670a779093bce77b73cb2fd370e68510c8f69e62 && git checkout -B drift-repro 91a423ef6b94a86be8874f1ac6449b406a8971c8 && git merge --no-ff 670a779093bce77b73cb2fd370e68510c8f69e62

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 91a423ef6b94a86be8874f1ac6449b406a8971c8
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 91a423ef6b94a86be8874f1ac6449b406a8971c8` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review · DELIBERATE CORRECTION confirmation

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `670a779093bce77b73cb2fd370e68510c8f69e62`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/services/service-analytics/src/analytics-service.ts, packages/services/service-analytics/src/measure-currency-coherence.ts, packages/services/service-analytics/src/__tests__/record-currency-analytics.test.ts, `.changeset/28049-derived-sum-fixed-currency-column.md`, and the rewritten pending note `.changeset/28019-derived-measure-fixed-currency.md` (from #28043, merged, not yet released)

Owed because this PR rewrites a pending release note it made false and also changes code: the confirmation is a same-head review record that judges each rewritten sentence. `Clause-②: no`; the diff touches no `packages/spec/src/**` and no governed path, so the tier is `TIER_DEFAULT`, written by the lane seat.

### ① Rewritten sentences, judged one by one

**Note: `.changeset/28019-derived-measure-fixed-currency.md`, the first bullet's last sentence (the only line changed in that file).**

- Before: "… and the fix: restate the operands' code as the measure's `currency`, or delete it (the column then carries no currency code; a derived column takes no code from its operands on the wire)."
- After: "… and the fix: delete the measure's `currency` (the column takes the operands' code), or restate that code."
- Judgment: **the old sentence is false at this head, the new one is true.** `enrichResultColumns` (`analytics-service.ts`) now sets `fc.currency` from `currencies.fixedCodeOf(m)` when a derived measure declares no `currency` and its operands resolve to one `fixed` code, so "takes no code from its operands on the wire" no longer holds. With the measure's `currency` deleted the column carries the operands' code (pinned: `eur_twice` / `eur_net` → `EUR` on every strategy and on the draft-preview path). Restating the code still compiles (`eur_twice_restated` → `EUR`, and the note's next bullet, unchanged, says so). The reorder puts the no-config fix first, matching the field-level sentence in `content/docs/data-modeling/currency.mdx` ("Delete the measure's `currency`, and the column takes the field's code"). Nothing else in the note moved: the BREAKING banner, the refusal's scope, its code `DATASET_INVALID` / 400 and the "Not judged" paragraph are untouched and still true.

**Refusal message: `measure-currency-coherence.ts`, guard 1 derived branch (what the note quotes).**

- Before: "… so the column would print them as {declared}: restate the operands' {code} as the measure's `currency`, or delete it (the column then carries no currency code)."
- After: "… so the column would print them as {declared}: delete the measure's `currency` (the column takes the operands' {code}), or restate {code}."
- Judgment: **true, and it matches the note.** Same refusal, same code and status, same trigger; only the remedy text changes, and it now says what the column does. The pin moved with it (`record-currency-analytics.test.ts`, the `toContain` on the new wording).

**New note: `.changeset/28049-derived-sum-fixed-currency-column.md`.** Each sentence matches the diff: the column carries the one `fixed` code on the live query and the draft preview; the code is read from the compile guard's own resolution (`measureCurrencyResolver`, shared with `assertMeasureCurrenciesCoherent`); the "Unchanged" list is the test's six controls (mixed fixed + tenant, two tenant amounts, an explicit code over a dynamic field, a record-mode amount, a `ratio`, a `product`).

### ② Derived judgments

- **One derivation.** `assertMeasureCurrenciesCoherent` and the column now read one resolver (`measureCurrencyResolver`); the refactor moves the existing memoised resolution out unchanged and adds `fixedCodeOf`. The column cannot claim a code compile did not judge.
- **Order of precedence.** `mc.currency ?? meta?.defaultCurrency ?? derivedCode ?? context?.currency`: a declared measure `currency` still wins (and a contradicting one is refused at compile); the tenant currency is reached only when nothing else resolves, as before.
- **Fails safe.** `fixedCodeOf` answers only for a `fixed` code; tenant-currency, record-mode, mixed and `ratio` / `product` measures stay unlabelled, as before.
- **Clause-② `no` stands.** `currency` is an existing optional member of a result column; no member, error code or accept set is added. `measureCurrencyResolver` is not re-exported from the package entry (`src/index.ts`). The column now says what the currency page and the field-level rule already say.
- Wrong: none found.

### ③ Semver level

- `@objectstack/service-analytics` `patch`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, line-initial. The LEVEL AXIS step of Check Changeset is green at this head.

### ④ Designed red: gate and cause

- **Gate:** `Check Changeset` (`pr-automation.yml`, job `changeset-check`), step `check-empty-changeset`, run 41061995413 / job 124083774429.
- **Cause:** this PR changes `.changeset/28019-derived-measure-fixed-currency.md`, a pending note it did not add. That is the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class: the code change made the note's sentence false, so it was rewritten in the same stroke and must not be restored. The script says so itself: it is red by design on the pushed branch and "stays red either way". This record is the confirmation the remedy asks for. The other steps of that job (ADR-0087 registration, the live allow-major read, the major guard) ran and are green.
- `pr-automation.yml` triggers on `pull_request` only, so the gate does not run on `merge_group`.

### ⑤ Design judgment

- Labelling the column from the compile guard's own resolution is the right altitude: one reading for both what compile refuses and what the wire prints, and the derived case now behaves like the field case. Out of scope, carded by the seat: #28127 (a nested derived measure refused on the live query).

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-uoae54`
Reviewed-by: `session_016WV4czuTWNgKR22fKv7jia (lane seat)`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 数据集派生度量（`sum` / `difference`）的各操作数若都固定为同一币种（如都是 EUR），查询结果列现在带上该币种代码 `EUR`；以前是不带币种的裸数字，前端会把欧元当无币种数字打印（#28049）。实时查询与 Studio 草稿预览一致。
- **为什么改：** 币种文档早已写明「同一 fixed 币种上的派生 sum/difference 带该币种」，回答却没有做到；编译期守卫已经算出了这个币种，只是结果列没用上。
- **风险与回滚：** 结果列直接读编译守卫同一个解析结果（`measureCurrencyResolver`），列上写的就是编译判过的；度量自己声明的 `currency` 仍优先；租户币种、记录币种、混合币种、`ratio` / `product` 仍不带。回滚即还原 service-analytics 两个源文件。
- **先看：** `analytics-service.ts` 的 `enrichResultColumns` 中 `derivedCode` 一段，和 `measure-currency-coherence.ts` 抽出的 `measureCurrencyResolver`。
- **两分钟验证：** 跑 `record-currency-analytics.test.ts` 新增的 describe（三种策略 + 草稿预览，3 个应带币种、6 个对照不带）。
- **需要你做的：** 无。本 PR 改写了尚未发布的说明 `.changeset/28019-derived-measure-fixed-currency.md` 的一句（旧句在本修复后为假），`Check Changeset` 按设计红；同 head 复核记录 6523892478 已逐句判定并确认，按本期落地授权带红入队。

## 席位核对

- **Shape:** draft → main, `Fixes #28049`. 5 files (+133/−20): `analytics-service.ts`, `measure-currency-coherence.ts`, one test file, a new changeset, and the one-sentence correction of the pending 28019 note. `check-governed-merges --pr 28122`: NOT governed.
- **Premise:** re-measured on `main` by the thread: a derived `sum` over two EUR-fixed measures reached `POST /analytics/dataset/query` with no `currency` on its column.
- **File surface:** within the claim (service-analytics source, tests, `.changeset/*`).
- **Declarations:** `Clause-②: no` (`currency` is an existing optional column member; no new member, error code or export from the package entry), `Metadata-protocol: none`, `@objectstack/service-analytics` `patch`. Check Changeset's LEVEL AXIS step agrees.
- **DELIBERATE CORRECTION:** note `.changeset/28019-derived-measure-fixed-currency.md` (#28043, merged, unreleased). Before: "…or delete it (the column then carries no currency code; a derived column takes no code from its operands on the wire)." After: "…delete the measure's `currency` (the column takes the operands' code), or restate that code." Confirmed sentence by sentence in the same-head `TIER_DEFAULT` record 6523892478 (**PASS**), which also judges the refusal message rewritten in `measure-currency-coherence.ts`.
- **Carrying the red (all three conditions hold):** (1) `scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs` describes this class as red by design on the pushed branch ("this gate stays red either way"); (2) `pr-automation.yml` runs on `pull_request` only, so `Check Changeset` does not run on `merge_group`; (3) record 6523892478 names the gate (job 124083774429) and the cause. The job's other steps (ADR-0087 registration, allow-major read, major guard) are green.
- **Gate check-runs on this head:** 48 total, 0 pending; all success or path-filter skipped except `Check Changeset` (the designed red above). `mergeable_state: unstable` from that red only.
- **Out of scope:** #28127 (a nested derived measure refused on the live query), carded by the seat.
- **Review request:** the card thread requested `os-elon-musk` before the seat's instruction reached it; Tier S needs no human review, and the relay cannot withdraw a request. It is not a merge condition.
- **Landing:** Tier S, under the maintainer's landing grant for this term (2026-10-29 22:05Z, seat thread). Ready + auto-merge through the relay.

**ACCEPT**
